It does not specify placement at the tip of a tube apparatus or establish the full mechanism with the certainty of the claim. These are evidence gaps, not direct contradictions."},{"id":"680","label":"contradicts","confidence":0.99,"aspects":{"polarity":"inconsistent","quantifiers":"The general claim about mice exceeds the tested genotype.","population":"Experiments concern apolipoprotein E(-/-) mice.","causality":"Experimental FGF21 deficiency is reported to cause premature death, the opposite of increased life expectancy.","hedging":"The source directly reports the adverse effect in the studied model.","numeric_context":"No lifespan estimates are provided."},"evidence":[{"source_id":"9315213","quote":"FGF21 deficiency causes a marked exacerbation of atherosclerotic plaque formation and premature death in apolipoprotein E(-/-) mice, which is accompanied by hypoadiponectinemia and severe hypercholesterolemia."}],"rationale":"FGF21 deficiency produces premature death in the studied mice, contradicting the claimed increase in life expectancy. The finding is limited to the apolipoprotein E(-/-) model."},{"id":"422","label":"insufficient","confidence":0.99,"aspects":{"polarity":"uncertain","quantifiers":"No flexible-versus-rigid comparison is reported.","population":"The source studies quantum dots and tumor imaging, not specified flexible and rigid molecules.","causality":"No effect of molecular flexibility on steric hindrance is tested.","hedging":"The categorical comparison lacks supporting evidence.","numeric_context":"Particle sizes are mentioned without numerical values or flexibility conditions."},"evidence":[{"source_id":"11172205","quote":"Moreover, we used them to measure the ability of particles of different sizes to access the tumor."}],"rationale":"The source discusses tumor access by particles of different sizes.
